doc.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024

title: Closing thanks and Playing the Changes
summary: Monk thanks Darius and praises the book title; goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yes, and I think we did take it for granted and I think you should be able to speak like that on CNN. So Darius, thank you for your time today. I wish you the best of luck with all the projects you have going on. I think you chose — whoever chose “Playing the Changes,” the title —
It’s spot on because you know playing the changes presents these issues to solve.
Like you’ve been solving issues for most of your life and doing it very well.
Well thank you very much, Monk.
All right. I’ll say good-bye and best wishes to you.
